Repo: falcon-bug-fix-agent (Node, plain CommonJS; tests: `npm test`, single file `node --test test/<file>.test.js` — always a FILE path). Read .claude/skills (bot-safety-gates, bot-pipeline-internals) before touching src/pipeline.js.

Problem (live 2026-10-06, seo thread 1791210973.238389): the techlead had already tagged the dev who owns FAL-1099 (<@U08RFSYS5D5>, tunglv) in the thread. Called in with bypassClaim, the bot reached the TAG branch (src/pipeline.js `if (decision === "TAG")`, ~:723) and tagged the git-history owner from resolveOwner instead — the techlead himself. A dev already assigned in the thread must be the one tagged.

Required change:
1. Add a pure exported helper in src/pipeline.js, e.g. `threadAssignees(thread, { engineer, roster, slackRoster })` -> string[] of Slack UIDs: dev/techlead mentions made in thread replies by an engineer (reuse the same rules classifyThread uses: skip bot authors, MENTION_RE, engineerUids/claim roles, then filterAssignableMentions), excluding the mentioning author themself, de-duplicated, in first-seen order. It must work regardless of bypassClaim (bypassClaim sets `claimed = null`, so do not depend on `claimed`).
2. TAG branch: if threadAssignees(...) is non-empty, tag those UIDs and skip resolveOwner; otherwise keep today's resolveOwner behaviour unchanged. report.tagReply currently takes a single ownerId — extend it minimally (e.g. accept an array or a pre-joined mention string) without changing its output for the single-owner case.
3. Ledger entry for TAG: `tagged` records the assignee(s) the same way it records the owner today.

Tests: new test/pipeline-assignees.test.js — helper: assignee mentioned by techlead -> returned; mention by CS/unknown author -> ignored; a tester-only mention -> ignored per filterAssignableMentions; bot messages ignored; author excluded. TAG wiring: with an assigned dev in the thread the posted text tags that UID and resolveOwner is not used (stub ctx like test/pipeline-fixpath.test.js does). Whole `npm test` must stay green; test count only grows. No commits.

contract.goal: When a dev is already assigned in the thread, the TAG reply tags that dev instead of the git-history owner
